Is your green pipeline real?

Argus links JSM incidents to linked Bitbucket work, fires a synthetic canary to expose fake-green gates, and returns a re-verified repair patch. This page runs the same twenty Elenchos rules as the Forge app, in your browser, on text you control.

Status: demo build. It evaluates the Bitbucket Pipelines YAML below directly in your browser. It does not connect to your Atlassian site and sends nothing anywhere.

RuleChecksResult

Exit 1 means at least one rule failed on these facts. Exit 0 means all twenty passed on the facts the extractor could see. One fact, required merge check enforcement (r13), lives in Bitbucket branch restrictions, not in this file, so here it stays flagged until the app reads it from the API. Each rule earned its id by separating a violating fixture (exit 1) from a clean one (exit 0) in the Socratic Kill-Test. A check that cannot separate the two is thrown out before a human sees it.
